dedupe_keys.name: eau reseaux eaux usees et eaux pluviales grand poitiers donnees metiers

description: Eau - Réseaux eaux usées et eaux pluviales - Grand Poitiers Données métiers is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sig.grandpoitiers.fr. The wastewater collection system is represented by different categories: discharge, wastewater collector and mixed system (both rainwater and used water systems are together). The mixed network exists only for the city centre. The area covered is that of the 13 municipalities of Grand Poitiers. The update is done over the water. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Water — Wastewater and stormwater systems — Grand Poitiers Business data" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include eaux pluviales, réseau unitaire, réseau mixte, données ouvertes, eaux usées, réseau d'eaux usées. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2015-02-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
